text:
Incident-Bot: Pager: elevated 5xx rate detected on gateway (5.8% over 15m) for /v1/generate — paging #incidents and @oncall. AlertID: alert-gtwy-502-1976543210
Alex: I’m on it, looking at edge-proxy logs now. first glance shows surge of upstream 502/504s starting ~10:12 UTC.
Morgan: I’m seeing increased latencies on model runtime too, but hard to correlate — traces for those requests look mostly missing. can anyone confirm trace sampling is on for gateway?
Devon: trace sampling looks set to 0.01 for prod gateway globally. not enough to catch this pattern. also noticed many requests have no x-request-id header — makes correlating logs -> traces impossible.
Paige: customer impact: a handful of customers reported generation failures and timeouts. working with support to gather customer IDs and affected routes. Support-Bot: pushing customer list to #support (link) and opening a high-priority ticket template.
Alex: quick mitigation plan: 1) add temporary req-id injector in gateway to ensure each request has X-Request-Id 2) bump trace sampling for /v1/generate to 10% for 20 minutes 3) enable debug logging for gateway route to capture upstream response payloads if any. will push as hotfix.
Rory: agree. We should avoid full prod-wide debug — target the route. Also set a short TTL on sampled traces to avoid retention storm.
Devon: patch ready for review. snippet below — quick middleware we can hotpatch into edge-proxy (python-flask example):
```python
from uuid import uuid4
@middleware
def inject_reqid(request):
    if 'X-Request-Id' not in request.headers:
        request.headers['X-Request-Id'] = uuid4().hex
    request.ctx.req_id = request.headers['X-Request-Id']
    logger.bind(req_id=request.ctx.req_id).debug('gateway: req start', path=request.path)
    return handler(request)
```
Alex: I’ll deploy the middleware to the canary pool (10% of traffic) and route a small percentage of affected customers to it to validate correlation. if stable, expand to 100%.
SRE-Bot: Deploy job queued: edge-proxy/hotpatch-reqid v4 -> canary (10%) by Alex. CI checks passed for quick-lint and unit mocks.
Morgan: while Alex deploys, I’ll flip trace sampling for that route: Datadog rule updated: "service:gateway AND http.path:/v1/generate" sample_rate=0.10 until +20m. Also adding temporary log tag "incident-1976543210" to help search.
Paige: Support: notify affected enterprise customers that engineering is investigating and we have a mitigation in progress. message draft: "We’re aware of intermittent timeouts/5xx for generation requests, mitigation in progress, we’ll follow up." PTL signoff?
Alex: rolling canary now. initial 5% of traffic routed through patched proxies. early logs show X-Request-Id attached for those requests. correlating to runtime logs…
Devon: good — I can follow those req_ids into runtime. however, we still see a subset of upstream host failures with truncated body causing 502s — might be a backend server OOM or sudden threadpool exhaustion. spinning up an additional runtime replica pool as a short-term relief.
Rory: spun up 8 extra workers on ded-prod-runtime, autoscaler adjusted to prefer new pods. keep an eye on tokenization latency.
Support-Bot: communicated interim status to customers at 10:34 UTC.
Alex: expanding patch to 100% after 3m with stable logs. also adding a short-term sampling rule to capture spans with errors (http.status >= 500) at 100% for 20m so we get trace data for failures.
Morgan: confirmed sampled error traces appearing. we now have full traces for some failing requests and a pattern emerges: upstream connection reset between gateway and runtime within first 200ms for large payloads.
Devon: that points to runtime side network buffer / worker limit. I’ll coordinate with eng-runtime to drop max payload size temporarily for generator endpoint and force a 413 for suspect large requests — reduces load. patch posted as PR and will be hotfixed after approvals.
SRE-Bot: On-call handoff reminder: Alex will hold incident for next 30 minutes, then hand to Morgan at 11:05 UTC unless escalated. please ack @oncall.
Paige: customer impact update: reduced error rate from 5.8% -> 1.2% after scaling + req-id + sampling. still some customers impacted, prioritized list sent to account teams.
Rory: added temporary dash to surface req_id and upstream host errors per minute. live link: (dash)
Alex: prepping post-incident checklist items: - ensure request-id injection is merged permanently in gateway - add low-latency trace sampling rule for errors by default - create alert for request-id absence rate > 1% - review runtime connection handling for large payloads
Paige: will file a customer RCA draft and coordinate with account teams for follow-up.
Support-Bot: ticket updated: INC-1976543210, severity P2, linked traces attached.
Alex: handing off active ownership to Morgan now — handing over notes and runbook steps in thread. Morgan, you take it?
Morgan: taking it. I’ll continue until stable/closed. Thanks all for quick moves. :thumbsup:
Paige: leaving final customer comm template in #support-drafts. will update when we have RCA.
Incident-Bot: Incident marked as "mitigated" at 11:10 UTC; monitoring window started. If error rate remains below 0.5% for 30m, incident will be closed automatically.
